# iaas_sandbox_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the account's persistent data volumes for sandboxes (iaas_sandbox_volume), with what each is attached to. Use an id in the volumes of iaas_microvm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the free volumes of the account and see what each other volume is attached to.
data "iaas_sandbox_volumes" "free" {
  status = "available"
}

output "free_volume_ids" {
  value = [for v in data.iaas_sandbox_volumes.free.volumes : v.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only the volume with exactly this name.
- `status` (String) Only volumes in this status: available, attached, attaching, detaching, pending, deleting or error.

### Read-Only

- `volumes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created.
- `delete_on_sandbox_delete` (Boolean) Whether the volume is deleted with the sandbox that holds it.
- `id` (String) Volume UUID.
- `location_id` (String) Location the volume lives in (on one node of it).
- `mount_path` (String) Where the holding sandbox mounts it; null while free.
- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox that holds the volume; null while it is free.
- `size_gib` (Number) Size in GiB.
- `status` (String) available, attached, attaching, detaching, pending, deleting or error.
